result.target_summary: In 2023, Intel updated its client compute brands to Intel, Intel Core, and Intel Core Ultra, with Intel Core representing highest volume in 2024. comparisons.peer_topic: AI Software Ecosystem and Silo AI Acquisition
comparisons.peer_summary: To support its AI strategy, AMD consolidated AI teams to develop a comprehensive software ecosystem, improved AMD ROCm software performance, and acquired Silo AI Oy to accelerate AI model development and deployment on AMD hardware, leveraging Silo's software stack for training large language models.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and AMD are actively expanding their AI capabilities through hardware and software ecosystem development in 2024, though they focus on different segments of the PC and computing markets. Intel is introducing the Intel Core Ultra family to the client market to drive 'AI PC' adoption with specific processor lines (200V for mobile, 200S for desktop) that feature AI advancements. Similarly, AMD is executing an AI strategy by consolidating teams and acquiring Silo AI to accelerate the development and deployment of AI models on its hardware, specifically leveraging its Instinct accelerators for training large language models. While Intel's disclosure centers on product launches targeting consumer and enthusiast PC refresh cycles, AMD's disclosure focuses on the strategic software and ecosystem investments required to support AI workloads across its portfolio.

sentences.text: The Intel Core Ultra processor family, which we launched at the end of 2023, delivers significant advancements in graphics, AI, and multi-threaded CPU performance and introduced the AI PC to the market.
In the second half of 2024, the next-generation Intel Core Ultra 200V Series became our highest performance client processors, with increased battery life for mobile PCs.
We also introduced the Intel Core Ultra 200S Series processors, catering to the desktop enthusiast market.
To execute our AI strategy, we brought together multiple AI teams across AMD to drive development of a comprehensive software ecosystem spanning our full product portfolio.
The acquisition of Silo AI enables customers to accelerate development and deployment of AI models on AMD hardware.

Silo AI has also developed a software stack used to train multiple state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) on AMD Instinct accelerators that can accelerate the development of highly-performant AMD training solutions.
